text:
¡What suavidad, what suavidad of raso,

what acariciar of plumas in el wind;

in terciopelos se apagó my paso

and in remansos of seda el pensamiento!


Todo impreciso is as in un cuento,

se desborda in silence as un vaso,

and in this tibia languidez of ocaso

desfallecer until morir me siento.


As un panal disuélvome in dulzura,

desfallezco of todo: of ternura,

of claridad, of the éxtasis of verte…


And todo tan lejano, tan lejano…

In this atardecer your frágil hand

pudiera with un lirio darme Death…

translation.title: Convalecencia
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
